ai_notes: a1 T3: Runerigus at 16 HP attacked (Poltergeist, 79 on the incoming Rillaboom) rather than guarding, then guarded T4 against a real KO. That is the cadence the September 15 decision asks for.

a1 T6: Mega Camerupt chose Eruption at full HP (the authored payoff move) while slower than a Mega Swampert with a revealed 4x Liquidation, and died before moving. Protect (as a2 chose) would only have delayed the same KO by a turn. Neither choice is wrong on the mixed forecast; noted because it is the exact board where build-8 produced the consecutive Protect, and build-15 produced no repeat.

Copperajah a1 T6 Heavy Slam into Mega Swampert (resisted, 82) when High Horsepower was neutral into the same target - very mild; a1 T7 it was already asleep. a2 T6 Heavy Slam into the Amoonguss slot for 191 was the strongest available hit.
Wide Guard again never chosen by Stakataka (5 decisions across both runs); Surf was never shown, so no spread threat was on the board.
Trick Room re-selection on an expiring room did not arise (Runerigus never faced a down room).
Rillaboom's a2 T3 death was a 1/24 critical Stone Edge on a switch-in; the non-crit line (137 + 79) leaves it alive.

Under the brief's rule (won with 0-1 faints and no real threat -> +1 on the weakest one or two non-Mega members) the lowest non-Mega offset is Copperajah's 3; Torterra and Rhyperior already carry 4 and Torterra's turn-1 death is a double-target, not a level problem. One member, +1, within the pass's max.
